title: Fix Missing Border on Untoggled Panel Toggle Chips
description: The panel toggle chips in the navbar are missing their border outline when untoggled (panel is folded/closed). The `WindowChrome chipOnly` render path does not include a `WindowChromeSilhouetteBorder`, so there is no SVG silhouette border drawn around the chip cap when in chipOnly mode. The border is only shown for the fully-expanded `WindowChrome` (non-chipOnly) via the silhouette SVG. Fix: add `WindowChromeSilhouetteBorder` to the `chipOnly` branch in `WindowChrome` in `/Users/ueli/Documents/semio/🧰️framework/🔨️module/🖱️ui/⚛️react/⚡️implementation/🟦️typescript/📦️index.tsx`.
summary: Fixed missing border on untoggled panel toggle chips in the navbar. The `WindowChrome chipOnly` render path (used by `PanelChromeTabBar`) was missing a `WindowChromeSilhouetteBorder` component, so no SVG silhouette border was drawn around chip caps when the panel is folded. Added `<WindowChromeSilhouetteBorder stack={stackEl} active={active} borderKind={borderKind} />` to the chipOnly branch. Also extended the existing test to assert the silhouette border element is present in both folded `PanelChromeTabBar` and folded `Panel`.
